title: Accounts Note: Diagnostic Charges, Payments and Waivers on Workmanship Warranties Coverages
content:
A Workmanship Warranties coverage carries an account of what the customer owes for warranty inspections that found a concern not covered: diagnostic charges post in; payments and waivers post out. What remains owed on a charge is its amount less the payments and waivers naming it.

## Clauses in force

1. **Payment.** The customer pays a diagnostic charge by card, cash or check.
2. **Settled charges.** A charge that is already paid or waived in full takes no further payment or waiver.
3. **Billing-error waiver.** A billing-error waiver removes a charge posted against the rule above.
4. **Goodwill waiver.** A goodwill waiver is limited to the plan's goodwill authority per charge, and a request beyond it is declined at the desk.

## Retired clause

The clause "An inspection that finds a concern not covered posts a diagnostic charge of the plan's diagnostic fee only when the concern type is in the plan's fee-bearing concern types; every other inspection is free, covered or not." is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for posting diagnostic charges on warranty inspections. The plan figures it named, the diagnostic fee, the fee-bearing concern types and the goodwill authority per charge, remain the plan's figures.

## Condition on a payment or waiver

The condition is judged on the coverage's account records, for the charge the payment or waiver names: a charge that is already paid or waived in full takes no further payment or waiver.

| Account shows for the named charge | Further payment or waiver |
|---|---|
| Payments and waivers naming it already equal its amount (paid or waived in full) | none taken |
| Payments and waivers naming it are less than its amount | the condition does not bar it |

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical charge of USD 60.00 has a goodwill waiver of USD 20.00 naming it. What remains owed is USD 60.00 less USD 20.00, which is USD 40.00; the charge is not settled in full, so the condition does not bar a payment by card, cash or check. Once a payment of USD 40.00 naming it is recorded, the charge is paid or waived in full and takes no further payment or waiver.

Payment methods recognized: card, cash, check. Waiver reasons recognized: goodwill, billing error.

superseded_clauses: An inspection that finds a concern not covered posts a diagnostic charge of diagnostic_fee_usd only when the concern type is in the plan's diagnostic_fee_concern_types; every other inspection is free, covered or not.
